# Set the data path for Chrono assets

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

chassis_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH
suspension_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES
steering_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES
wheel_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_NONE
tire_vis_type = veh.VisualizationType_MESH

# Point on the chassis tracked by the camera

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Simulation end time

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Noise model for the sensors
noise_model = "NONE"  # No noise model

# Update rate in Hz for the sensors
update_rate = 10

# Image width and height for cameras
image_width = 1280
image_height = 720

# Camera's horizontal field of view
fov = 1.408

# Lag (in seconds) between sensing and when data becomes accessible
lag = 0

# Exposure time (in seconds) for each image
exposure_time = 0

# View camera images
vis = True

# Create the vehicle, set parameters, and initialize
gator = veh.Gator()
gator.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
gator.SetChassisFixed(False)
gator.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
gator.SetBrakeType(veh.BrakeType_SHAFTS)
gator.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
gator.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

gator.SetWheelVisualizationType(wheel_vis_type)
gator.SetTireVisualizationType(tire_vis_type)

print("Driveline type: " + gator.GetVehicle().GetDriveline().GetTemplateName())

print("Tire type:      " + gator.GetVehicle().GetTire(1, veh.LEFT).GetTemplateName())

# Set collision system type

box.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5))

cam.SetName("Third Person POV")
# Renders the image at current point in the filter graph

manager.AddSensor(cam)

# create lidar sensor
offset_pose = chrono.ChFramed(
        chrono.ChVector3d(0.0, 0, 2), chrono.QuatFromAngleAxis(0, chrono.ChVector3d(0, 1, 0))

)
lidar.SetName("Lidar Sensor")

"""
Create a PyChrono simulation featuring a Gator vehicle, including its initialization and visualization with various vehicle parts set to different visualization types. import pychrono
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.animation as animation

# Simulation parameters
simulation_time = 100  # Simulation duration in seconds
time_step = 0.1  # Time step for simulation
gravity = 9.81  # Acceleration due to gravity
terrain_heightmap = np.zeros((100, 100))  # Example terrain heightmap - adjust as needed
vehicle_speed = 0.5  # Initial vehicle speed
driver_speed = 0.2  # Initial driver speed
sensor_range = 10  # Sensor range in meters
camera_resolution = 256 # Resolution of camera images
point_light_intensity = 100 # Intensity of the point light
point_light_color = np.random.rand(3) # Random color for the point light

# Initialize PyChrono environment
chrono = pychrono.Chrono()

# Create the Gator vehicle
vehicle = chrono.Vehicle(
    id="Gator",
    position=[0, 0, 0],  # Initial position in meters
    velocity=[0, 0, 0],  # Initial velocity in meters per second
    speed=vehicle_speed,
    acceleration=0.0,
    mass=10.0,
    orientation=np.eye(4)  # Initial orientation (e.g., all angles are 0)
)

# Create the terrain
terrain = chrono.Terrain(
    id="Terrain",
    heightmap=terrain_heightmap,
    height_scale=1.0,
    height_map_size=100, # Adjust heightmap size as needed
    # Add a simple slope for demonstration
    slope_factor=0.1
)

# Create the driver system
driver = chrono.Driver(
    id="Driver",
    position=[0, 0, 0],
    velocity=[0, 0, 0],
    speed=driver_speed,
    acceleration=0.0,
    mass=10.0,
    orientation=np.eye(4)
)

# Create sensor manager
sensor_manager = chrono.SensorManager(
    id="SensorManager",
    sensor_types=["point_light", "camera"],
    sensor_positions=[
        (0, 0, 0),  # Point light position
        (0, 0, 10)  # Camera position
    ],
    sensor_ranges=[sensor_range]
)

# Set initial parameters
chrono.set_parameters(
    gravity=gravity,
    terrain_heightmap=terrain_heightmap,
    vehicle_speed=vehicle_speed,
    driver_speed=driver_speed,
    sensor_range=sensor_range,
    camera_resolution=camera_resolution,
    point_light_intensity=point_light_intensity,
    point_light_color=point_light_color
)

# Simulation loop
for t in range(simulation_time):
    # Update driver
    driver.update()

    # Update terrain
    terrain.update()

    # Update vehicle
    vehicle.update()

    # Update sensor manager
